nodes.label: Player
details: Description tab next to Comments, with clickable timestamps and chapters built from the description.
YouTube's most replayed graph above the scrubber.
Loop a section of a video with the brackets button.
Ctrl+wheel zooms into a paused frame up to 8x.
Next up panel with a now-playing card, watch progress and a sort menu.
End cards with the creator's avatar and a Hide button.

nodes.label: Settings
details: Keyboard shortcuts tab (Ctrl+/) where every hotkey can be rebound.

nodes.label: Appearance
details: Black theme with your accent in video mode, Legacy colors brings back the brown.
App density (Cozy or Compact) slims the title bar and side rail, and both can hide while a video plays.

nodes.label: Library
details: Tag videos by hand, with tag chips and a page per tag.
Finished downloads fly into their card in the Video Library.

nodes.label: Mini player
details: Ghost mode (Ctrl+Alt+G) with a chapter readout.

nodes.label: Notifications
details: Filter the island by uploads or downloads and mute each kind.

nodes.label: Downloads
details: Zen browser as a sign-in cookie source.

nodes.label: Music
details: Settings opens inside Music, and Add from screenshots on a playlist.

nodes.label: Activity
details: A private local activity log for future stats; nothing is uploaded.

nodes.label: Downloads
details: Closing the downloader right after clicking Download no longer drops the download.
A rate-limited caption no longer fails the whole video, and errors show yt-dlp's real message.
Video size estimates count the video stream instead of only the audio.
Edge, Brave and Safari leave the cookie list because yt-dlp cannot read them on Windows.

nodes.label: Player
details: Auto captions show the original transcript in complete phrases.
Downloads saved without chapters or the replay graph fetch them once when opened.

nodes.label: Music
details: One click plays a song in a playlist.
Synced lyrics load for label uploads, and the lyrics header no longer covers the lines.
Profile and stats show a loading state instead of empty zeros.
The player bar drops a track whose file was deleted.

nodes.label: Dynamic Island
details: No longer freezes at the end of a song on repeat or after seeking back.

nodes.label: App
details: Switching between Library and Music keeps each mode's scroll and open page.
